# shape

## Cover and float roles

- `radiusCover` (`--radius-cover`, `rounded-cover`) — a record's cover: the
  DataView gallery card and the list's leading thumbnail. Default = the raised
  card's `--radius-card`.
- `radiusFloat` (`--radius-float`, `rounded-float`) — floating chrome
  (`Surface level="float"`). Default = `--radius-popover`, so float and overlay
  round alike until a theme sets them apart.
